content.safeShedding: Reduce the number of subjects before relaxing the definition of a safe state.
content.counterplay: Contest a baseline, open emergency routes, overload sinks, change surface pressure, or sever a vault's anchor.
content.mastery: Masters keep surface alternatives and ordinary ventilation viable, restoring the capacity to live rather than making underground dependence permanent.

title: The World Bell
description: Makes every consenting stone, road, mountain, building, and breath within a nation sound one shared event in a locally meaningful voice, marking peace, warning, mourning, or a change of age.

facts.carrier: institution, unique site, and debt plan.

content.purpose: Makes every consenting stone, road, mountain, building, and breath within a nation sound one shared event in a locally meaningful voice, marking peace, warning, mourning, or a change of age.
content.practice: Communities choose participation, wording, silence, timing, and the material through which they will answer; no capital tone is primary.
content.consequence: The event becomes physically unforgettable, distant ground answers in return, wildlife and structures resonate, and political unity gains dangerous material weight.
content.failure: The Bell manufactures consent, cracks weak structures, silences nonparticipation, or continues ringing because the nation cannot agree that the age has changed.

content.counterplay: Refuse participation, answer out of phase, isolate material, invoke local silence, or unbind the central event.
content.mastery: Sovereign mastery leaves many tones unresolved, protects those who do not ring, and lets the Wonder end without proving that the nation was ever one voice.
